method: Calibration only. No full acquisition, no full-text ingestion, no 10K pilot.

sample.selection: newest submissions per primary category (cs.LG, cs.CL, cs.AI, stat.ML), 3 each, via export.arxiv.org API, primary-category filtered

quality.scoring_method: Deterministic calibration heuristic (no LLM). correctness: abstract length; reasoning_depth: abstract structure + methodology markers; explanation_quality: abstract length/structure; provenance_confidence: method+evidence+source.url present, capped at 4 (verification.status=needs_review).

extraction_feasibility.note: Abstract + metadata extraction only (per plan). Full-text/section extraction NOT performed in calibration; retraction check via abs-page markers (measured).
extraction_feasibility.license_note: arXiv API does not expose per-paper license field; source registered with arXiv default non-exclusive license per plan 2.3. Custom per-paper licenses (e.g., CC-BY) not detectable via API metadata — flag for human review if required.

recommendation_rule: STOP if security flags > 0 OR retraction markers > 0 OR conversion success < 80%; HOLD if conversion < 100% OR schema pass < 0.99 OR KEEP rate < 0.80 OR duplicate rate > 0.02 OR quality mean < 7 OR sample < 10; else GO.
